autoharness consumer feedback: the backlogit item status state machine has NO path back to 'queued' from any later state. A blocked item can only resume as 'active' (blocked -> active); it cannot return to 'queued' at all, because 'active' also has no transition to 'queued'. The doctor doc contradicts this. CONFIRMED 2026-07-23: (1) internal/config/defaults.go default Transitions map: queued:{active,blocked}, active:{done,blocked,review,shipped,abandoned}, blocked:{active}, review:{done,accepted,rejected}, done:{archived} -- neither blocked nor active can reach queued. (2) docs/cli-reference/backlogit_doctor.md long-help says 'backlogit move {id} --status blocked (and --status queued to resume)' -- documents a blocked->queued transition that runtime enforcement rejects. Runtime enforcement is the pre-hook hooks.ValidateStatusTransition (internal/hooks/builtin_pre.go:36), wired in internal/core/workspace.go:118 and gated by config Lifecycle.ValidateTransition (validate_transition); the standalone core.ValidateTransition helper (internal/core/harness_status.go:28) is not the production enforcement path. DECISION NEEDED (Stage): either add a return-to-ready transition (blocked->queued and/or active->queued) to the transition map, OR correct the doctor doc to '--status active'. Cross-check prior deliberation docs/decisions/2026-07-05-gate-repeated-failure-requeue-ownership-deliberation.md.
